name: create-once-concurrent-roots
description: WRIT-345 item 2 (spec/fold.md §5.2): create-once's race between two concurrent ROOT writers, not a sequential create-then-overwrite. op-b (bob) and op-a (alice) are two independent roots with equal t*=100; the total order's tiebreak on equal t* is the smaller op id, so op-a is reduced before op-b even though op-a's value ('zed') deliberately sorts after op-b's ('amy') -- the winner is decided by (t*, id) in L, never by comparing the values themselves.
